directory_policies.notes.5: Preparation: Requires a year of university science, mathematics through calculus, programming, data structures, computer organization and architecture. A generic science course does not prove a full year. Alternative preparation and the Bridge route require individual review; Bridge completion does not guarantee admission.

source_excerpt: At least 1 year of university-level science
fact_summary: The exact Tandon CS requirements include a full science year, calculus, programming, data structures, organization and architecture. Individual backgrounds and Bridge completion are not automatic admission guarantees.
